objects.name: Analytic 1925
objects.description: Real-time monitoring identifies a trusted, signed Windows system binary executing with command-line arguments inconsistent with its documented administrative purpose -- specifically arguments indicating payload decoding, remote content execution, or script invocation -- on an Industrial Control System (ICS) host. OT operational-fidelity gate: Alert only when execution violates an approved signer/hash/path/parent/process or tool allowlist, or originates from an unauthorized user/tool, and is tied to an OT asset or follow-on OT-relevant action. Suppress vendor-signed software, approved engineering utilities, diagnostics, patching, backup, and documented maintenance.

x_mitre_log_source_references.name: WinEventLog:Sysmon
x_mitre_log_source_references.channel: EventCode=1 image matches certutil.exe/regsvr32.exe/mshta.exe/rundll32.exe and command line matches Living-off-the-Land Binary (LOLBin) abuse patterns on host in Industrial Control Systems (ICS) workstation inventory
